capabilities: : Rewrites Bilibili URLs to embed player URLs
: Fits Canvas node size to 16:9 ratio
: Fetches and sets the real video title as the node label
extras: The plugin relies on undocumented Obsidian internals and is primarily designed for desktop use.
intentEvidence: Drop a Bilibili link onto an Obsidian Canvas and it becomes a real video player node — sized 16:9 and labelled with the actual video title
problem: Obsidian Canvas treats Bilibili video URLs as generic web pages, resulting in a small, fixed-size node and a generic label.
summary: Converts Bilibili video URLs in Obsidian Canvas into functional embedded player nodes, automatically resizing them to 16:9 and setting the actual video title as the node label.
